title: Securities Exchange Act of 1934 — Statute profile
subject: Securities Exchange Act of 1934
summary: Securities Exchange Act of 1934 is a statute of United States enacted in 1934, in the area of securities. Created the SEC and regulates securities trading and exchanges. It is formally cited as 48 Stat. 881.
key_points: Core effect: Created the SEC and regulates securities trading and exchanges.
Status: landmark statute of United States.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
